Simple Past

Click on any word to hear it. Clicca su una parola per ascoltarla.

Il tuo browser non supporta la sintesi vocale. Prova con Edge o Chrome.

📘 Da sapere

Il simple past corrisponde in italiano al passato remoto (mangiai, giocai, vidi), tuttavia in molte regioni dell'Italia settentrionale è più comune tradurlo con il passato prossimo (ho mangiato, ho giocato, ho visto).

Il simple past viene usato per parlare di azioni avvenute nel passato ove sia presente il marcatore temporale.

Tra i più comuni troviamo

  • Yesterday (ieri)
  • Ago ("fa" come nella frase "5 anni fa")
  • Last (scorso)
  • In + anno inferiore a quello attuale

Con espressioni quali:

  • When I was young → Quando ero giovane
  • When I was a child → Quando ero un bambino

✅ Forma affermativa

Verbo regolareVerbo irregolare
Aggiungo -ED alla forma base del verbo. Prendo il verbo della 2ª colonna dei verbi irregolari.
Ex: I WATCH → I WATCHED Ex: I SEE → I SAW TO SEE — SAW — SEEN

I verbi irregolari si usano soltanto nella forma AFFERMATIVA: nella forma negativa e interrogativa non sono più irregolari, utilizzeremo l'ausiliare DID. Questa regola non si applica per il verbo essere.

⚠️ Attenzione alle variazioni ortografiche

  1. Verbi regolari che terminano in -E, aggiungono solo la -D
    • SMILE → SMILED (sorridere)
    • LIKE → LIKED (piacere)
  2. Verbi regolari che terminano in -Y preceduta da una consonante trasformano la "Y" in "I" + ED
    • STUDY → STUDIED (studiare)
    • TRY → TRIED (provare)
  3. Verbi regolari che terminano con una sola consonante preceduta da una sola vocale, raddoppiano la consonante prima di aggiungere -ED
    • STOP → STOPPED (fermare)
    • CLAP → CLAPPED (applaudire)
    • ADMIT → ADMITTED (ammettere)

❓ Forma interrogativa

Simple present

Do / Does + soggetto + verbo forma base

Ex: Do/Does + you/she teach French?

InfinitiveSimple pastPast participle
To doDIDDone

Simple past

DID + soggetto + verbo forma base

Ex: DID + you/she + teach + French (last year)?

Frasi di esempio interrogative

Did I make a cake for Sara's birthday last week?
Did she bake the biscuits in the oven yesterday morning?
Did we suggest Luca to go on holiday one month ago?
Did they build this house in 1956?
Did my parents adopt my younger brother 3 years ago?
Did Mark leave for Paris 2 hours ago?
Did I visit London when I was young?
Did he study Maths for 3 hours last Monday afternoon?

❌ Forma negativa

Simple present

Soggetto + Do not / Don't / Does not / Doesn't + verbo forma base

Ex: You/She do not / Don't / Does not / Doesn't teach French

InfinitiveSimple pastPast participle
To doDIDDone

Simple past

Soggetto + DID not / Didn't + verbo forma base

Ex: Soggetto + DID not / Didn't teach French last year.

Frasi di esempio negative

I didn't make a cake for Sara's birthday last week.
She didn't bake the biscuits in the oven yesterday morning.
We didn't suggest Luca to go on holiday one month ago.
They didn't build this house in 1956.
My parents didn't adopt my younger brother 3 years ago.
Mark didn't leave for Paris 2 hours ago.
I didn't visit London when I was young.
I didn't study Maths for 3 hours last Monday afternoon.

📘 Simple Past — "TO BE"

Il verbo "TO BE" anche al simple past si comporta in modo diverso rispetto a tutti gli altri verbi. Presenta due forme diverse a seconda del soggetto.

1ª e 3ª singolare WAS I · he · she · it
2ª sing. · 1ª, 2ª, 3ª plurale WERE you · we · you · they

Può essere anche il tempo imperfetto: io ero, ecc. — non solo fui, fosti…

Esempi — Affermativa

I was late last Monday at the meeting
They were very hungry yesterday at dinner
She was pregnant last year

Negativa

I was not / wasn't late last Monday at the meeting
They were not / weren't very hungry yesterday at dinner
She was not / wasn't pregnant last year

Interrogativa

Was I late last Monday at the meeting?
Were they very hungry yesterday at dinner?
Was she pregnant last year?

Altri esempi

They were unhappy with their teacher last semester
You were very hungry yesterday at dinner
She was pregnant last year
Mike and Paul were very busy two days ago
There was the 2nd World War in 1943
